name: APL TV
description: Apple TV style IPTV player for your own M3U playlists and Xtream accounts: live TV with a guide, movies and series with TMDB pages, subtitles and audio menus, OpenSubtitles, Alexa voice search. No channels included, no root needed. The optional TMDB key adds posters, plots and cast.

fields.label: TMDB API key (v3), for posters, plots, cast and age ratings; optional
